newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Damansara cancels Antara Steel stake buy.
newsitem.headline: Damansara cancels Antara Steel stake buy.

text.p: Timber and construction firm Damansara Realty Bhd said in a statement on Tuesday it had cancelled its planned purchase of a stake in Antara Steel Mills Sdn Bhd.
The proposed acquisition, announced in January, was for 51 percent of the company for 208 million ringgit which would have been settled in cash.
The stake is currently held by the state of Johor in southern Malaysia.
"The board (of Damansara) is of the view that it is in the best interest of the company not to proceed with the proposed acquisition," said Damansara Realty
